input: Pick up prescription refill before Friday

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether the refill has already been requested/approved or still needs to be ordered determines how many steps are involved — it could be ready to collect, or require calling a doctor or pharmacy first.
Which pharmacy and its location, hours, and distance affect when and how the user can realistically get there before Friday.
The user's available days and times before Friday constrain when the pickup window actually is, especially if they have work or other commitments.
Whether the user needs to go in person or if delivery or curbside pickup is an option changes the action plan entirely.
If someone else — a family member, caregiver, or friend — could pick it up on the user's behalf, that opens up more scheduling flexibility.
Understanding why Friday is the deadline (e.g., running out of medication, leaving town) clarifies the urgency level and whether an earlier pickup is safer.
Some users want a simple reminder, others want a step-by-step action plan with calls to make — knowing the preferred level of support shapes how the plan is structured.

gold.taskTitle: Pick up prescription refill before Friday
gold.taskDescription: The user needs to collect a prescription refill from a pharmacy before a Friday deadline.

questions.title: Has the refill already been sent to the pharmacy?
questions.description: Determine whether the prescription has been requested from the doctor and approved, or whether that step still needs to happen before pickup is possible.

questions.title: Which pharmacy are you picking it up from?
questions.description: Identify the specific pharmacy — name, location, and operating hours — so the plan can account for travel and timing realistically.

questions.title: Which days and times are you free before Friday?
questions.description: Understand the user's available windows so the pickup can be scheduled at a realistic and convenient time.

questions.title: Can this prescription be delivered instead of picked up?
questions.description: Check whether home delivery, mail-order, or curbside pickup is an option, which could simplify or eliminate an in-person trip.

questions.title: Could someone else pick it up on your behalf?
questions.description: Establish whether a family member, friend, or caregiver is available and authorized to collect the prescription, adding scheduling flexibility.

questions.title: Why is Friday the hard deadline for this pickup?
questions.description: Clarify the reason for the deadline — such as running out of medication or traveling — to gauge true urgency and whether an earlier pickup is advisable.

questions.title: Do you want reminders or a full step-by-step action plan?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs only a nudge reminder or a detailed plan that includes calls to make, steps to confirm, and a pickup checklist.
